art_instructions: Draw the Dinosaur on his hands and knees, peeking under a low, round wooden table with stubby legs. His eyes are wide and focused, showing curiosity and mild concern. His short tail sticks out behind him, and his three-toed hands are spread wide as he leans forward to look. The table is brown with smooth edges and blocks most of his body from view, showing only his head, back, and elbows. His expression shows that he is searching carefully but not finding anything yet. Use soft pastel colors with a cel-shaded look and smooth outlines in Korean aegyo cute style. The background is simple with a light gradient floor to keep focus on the action. Position the camera at a low angle to reflect the child’s-eye view, as if a young child is watching the Dinosaur from nearby.
